question: An isotope of which of the following is used in the treatment of cancer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cobalt.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cobalt-60,** an** isotope of cobalt**, is commonly used in the** treatment of cancer.** 
 
• It emits** high-energy gamma rays,** which can **penetrate tissues and destroy cancer cells.**
 
• Cobalt-60 has a relatively** long half-life of 5.27 years, **which means it remains radioactive for a significant period. 
 
• This makes it **suitable for long-term treatment** and allows for the production and distribution of radioactive sources to medical facilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aluminum **

 
 
• Aluminum compounds are sometimes used in **antacids** to help** neutralize stomach acid and provide relief from heartburn or indigestion. **
 
• Additionally, aluminum-based adjuvants are **commonly used in vaccines** to **enhance the body's immune response **to the vaccine.
 
 
 
• **Nickel**
 
 
• It is sometimes used in** medical implants and devices, **such as** orthopedic implants or dental materials. **
 
• However, it's important to note that some individuals may have an allergic reaction to nickel, so its use in medical devices is carefully considered.
 
 
 
• **Iron**
 
 
• It is an **essential mineral** for the human body and is involved in various physiological processes. 
 
• **Iron supplements** are commonly prescribed to individuals with** iron deficiency or anemia. **
 
• Iron is necessary for the **production of red blood cells,** and supplements can help** restore iron levels** in the body.
